designer-initial.summary: Selected and audited a finite five-usage lifecycle governor with exact 5/11/11/5 small-scope counts and one principal decision owner.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted SysML-AADL/GUMBO subset realize the Lifecycle Governor's two owner-local state variables, safe initialization, and eleven ordered pre-state/post-state cases without duplicating or weakening the principal decision?
Can the exact eleven semantic interactions be preserved while any containment or delegation routes are separately traced as generated support, with a complete semantic-to-raw connection mapping?

Can all four nonprincipal usages retain their owner-local qualification or derivation contracts while charger-context qualification remains owner-local to the Lifecycle Governor and is not silently centralized elsewhere?
Can the retained bounded-analyzer mechanism independently enumerate all 2,560 snapshots and execute all five scenario families without using a copied architectural decision predicate as its oracle?

model-review.summary: The exact 5/11/11/5 allocation is owner-sound and realizable with 17 raw connections and complete bounded evidence.

findings.evidence: Extensional audit finds PART-01 maps 16 request/status samples to nine qualified results, PART-02 maps four battery/status samples to three evidence results, PART-03 combines qualified facts with two pre-state variables under eleven decision cases, PART-04 derives three independently meaningful command dimensions whose individual relations are 5-to-3 or 5-to-2, and PART-05 maps the 48-value disposition/battery product to six notices under priority. None merely copies, bundles, renames, or reroutes an input.

The trusted and currently accepted AADL pattern is System -> behavior-free Process -> semantic Threads. The six boundary semantic interactions each require two raw delegation connections and the five inter-usage interactions each require one, so INT-01..INT-11 map to exactly 17 raw PortConnection declarations without changing endpoints, types, directions, or meanings.
findings.requested_change: During generation, report the 11-to-17 semantic/raw mapping, mark the twelve boundary delegation declarations as generated support with their INT identifiers, and exclude the support Process and routes from semantic and owner credit.

findings.evidence: Trusted Isolette and accepted current repository sources demonstrate GUMBO state, initialize, In(...) pre-state guards, attribute-based record fields, multi-output guarantees, and compute cases. Those constructs can keep both state variables and all eleven mutually exclusive priority guards local to PART-03 while PART-01, PART-02, PART-04, and PART-05 retain separate local contracts.

Independent enumeration reproduced all 2,560 snapshots and the declared CASE-01..CASE-11 counts 2240, 140, 20, 20, 4, 1, 4, 2, 2, 4, and 123. The current harness executes a retained Node analyzer and checks source binding, passed status, zero diagnostics, Boolean checks, and ownership-audit agreement, so the required finite analysis and five ordered scenario traces fit the retained evidence mechanism without expanding the proof claim.

designer-resolution.summary: Model findings accepted with explicit 11-to-17 mapping and bounded-evidence claim refinement; generation is authorized.

model-generation.summary: Canonical source passed both retained Sireum gates, complete trace audit, and exhaustive bounded analysis.

visualization.summary: One validated system overview passed native, route-health, source-binding, and complete traceability review.

designer-final.summary: Canonical source, owner-local bounded semantics, and the retained system overview faithfully realize the Designer resolution without padding or silent drift.

reason: Canonical source, owner-local bounded semantics, and the retained system overview faithfully realize the Designer resolution without padding or silent drift.
